newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Nam Fatt share placement approved.
newsitem.headline: Nam Fatt share placement approved.

text.p: Infrastructure construction company Nam Fatt Bhd said on Wednesday its proposed private placement of 8.04 million new shares, or 10 percent of the existing paid-up capital, has been approved by the Securities Commission and Foreign Investment Committee.
Nam Fatt said in a statement the placement would help to improve group earnings by reducing interest payments. The shares were last traded at 8.55 ringgit on September 12.
The placement will increase the share capital of the group to 88.50 million shares, and group net tangible assets per share to 2.51 ringgit from 2.03 ringgit.
